name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.331.0 — policy.stops.prototypeClose now defaults to delete: the review MERGE step auto-picks deleting an unmerged prototype (its contract, pictures and tests stay under design/prototypes/<stem>/), prints the branch tip's restore command and the --prototype keep veto, and the DONE note repeats the restore command; a review STOPPED whose repair round is spent is answered by stops.reviewEscalate queue (queue /spec:fix, abandon as the veto) instead of a two-exit choice. 7.330.0 — /spec:fix reads the reject-with-evidence stop: pending-question.js gains stop-policy --root <dir> --key <key>, the prose commands' query of a stop's effective value (host policy.stops plus the fan-out --ask overlay), and fix.md step 4 accepts a reject the session backs with an executed repro when it prints accept, printing the review driver's vetoable Auto-picked line; waives and repro-less rejects are still asked. 7.329.0 — Queue items remember their origin: add carries --origin/--stage/--trigger, born fixes are admitted by origin and batch (shown with a ↳ from render), the batch walks in two passes, fix lanes run beside run lanes by named files with honoured after gates, a red main gets a repair lane, and MERGE refuses a dirty main root.
